budget.title: Half-Day Szentendre Mixed Budget Experience
budget.summary: A quick and affordable combination of Szentendre’s nature, culture, and traditional bites — perfect if you want a little bit of everything in just a few hours.

schedule.title: Fő Tér & Old Town Walk
schedule.description: Explore the colorful main square, narrow alleys, small gift shops, and the classic Szentendre charm.

schedule.title: Gallery or Small Museum Visit
schedule.description: Pick one of the many tiny galleries or a small local museum — quick, fun, and artsy.

schedule.title: Budget Local Lunch
schedule.description: Try a traditional Hungarian snack: lángos, goulash soup, or simple homemade dishes at local spots.

schedule.title: Short Walk by the Danube
schedule.description: Finish the route with a calm riverside stretch — great for relaxing before heading back.

comfortable.title: Half-Day Szentendre Mixed Comfort Tour
comfortable.summary: A pleasant combination of cultural sightseeing, light nature, and comfortable dining — all within half a day.

schedule.title: Old Town Exploration
schedule.description: Start with a slow walk through Szentendre’s historical center, capturing the architecture and atmosphere.

schedule.title: Museum or Private Gallery
schedule.description: Choose a well-curated museum or elegant gallery for a quick cultural boost.

schedule.title: Comfortable Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy a proper Hungarian meal in a charming sit-down restaurant — warm dishes and great flavors.

schedule.title: Riverside Walk
schedule.description: Spend the last part of the tour walking along the Danube, taking in the calm views before you wrap up.

budget.title: Half-Day Szentendre Veggie Mixed Budget Route
budget.summary: A light and affordable half-day mix of nature, culture, and vegetarian food.

schedule.title: Morning Walk in the Old Town
schedule.description: Browse small boutiques and charming streets while the town is still quiet.

schedule.title: Quick Gallery Visit
schedule.description: Choose a small art gallery for a short but inspiring stop.

schedule.title: Veggie Budget Snack or Lunch
schedule.description: Salads, soups, pastries, or simple vegetarian dishes at an affordable café.

schedule.title: Danube Riverside Break
schedule.description: Relax by the water with a drink or just enjoy the peaceful view.

comfortable.title: Half-Day Szentendre Veggie Mixed Comfort Tour
comfortable.summary: A balanced mix of cultural highlights, vegetarian dining, and riverside relaxation.

schedule.title: Calm Walk Through the Old Town
schedule.description: Visit charming alleys, pastel-colored houses, and artisan shops.

schedule.title: Art Gallery Stop
schedule.description: Pick a curated gallery featuring modern or traditional local art.

schedule.title: Vegetarian Lunch at a Comfortable Bistro
schedule.description: Try fresh salads, plant-based bowls, pasta dishes, or creative veggie mains.

schedule.title: Relaxing Riverside Walk
schedule.description: End with a peaceful stroll along the Danube — ideal for photos and unwinding.

budget.title: Half-Day Szentendre Tasting Mix (Budget)
budget.summary: A fun, budget-friendly half-day of tasting different small bites while exploring the town.

schedule.title: Bakery Tasting Start
schedule.description: Pick 2–3 pastries (sweet or savory) and walk through the Old Town as you taste.

schedule.title: Local Shops & Galleries
schedule.description: Hop through small artisan shops and pick a quick museum or gallery.

schedule.title: Street Food Mini-Lunch
schedule.description: Lángos, small sandwiches, or whatever local treat catches your eye.

schedule.title: Final Riverside Snack
schedule.description: Grab a final snack or drink and enjoy the Danube view.

comfortable.title: Half-Day Szentendre Tasting Comfort Tour
comfortable.summary: A half-day of curated flavors, cultural stops, and a scenic riverside ending.

schedule.title: Stylish Café Breakfast
schedule.description: Start with good coffee, a pastry, or a small breakfast plate.

schedule.title: Gallery or Museum Visit
schedule.description: Choose a beautifully curated gallery showcasing local talent.

schedule.title: Tasting-Style Lunch
schedule.description: Share two or three small dishes — a mini tasting of Hungarian flavors with a modern twist.

schedule.title: Calm Riverside Walk
schedule.description: Wrap up with a scenic Danube walk to digest the flavors and enjoy the view.
